FX.title: [USD/JPY] UP: AI Detects Support at MA20 as Fundamentals Turn Bullish
tldr_points: USD/JPY holds above MA20 support at 157.92, showing resilient bullish momentum.
Risk-on sentiment driven by Asian equity rebounds and AI sector strength supports JPY weakness.
RSI at 54.78 indicates room for upward extension without immediate overbought signals.
FX.excerpt: USD/JPY exhibits a bullish continuation pattern, holding firmly above the 20-day moving average as risk appetite returns to Asian markets.
FX.comment: Bullish trend intact above MA20 support, driven by risk-on momentum and favorable yield spreads.

STOCKS.title: [S&P 500] DOWN: Price Below MA20 as Inflation and Nvidia Losses Pressure AI Rally
tldr_points: S&P 500 closed below its 20-day moving average as hot inflation and Nvidia-related AI losses reinforced risk-off pressure.
RSI-14 at 39.85 signals weakening momentum without yet reaching oversold territory.
Strategy favors selling rallies toward key resistance while managing downside risk.
STOCKS.excerpt: S&P 500 slips below key averages as inflation and Nvidia losses fuel risk-off pressure.
STOCKS.comment: Price below MA20 with RSI weakening and inflation-driven risk-off supports bearish continuation.

CRYPTO.title: [BTC/USD] DOWN: CPI Push Triggers Breakdown Below MA20 as Momentum Tests Oversold
tldr_points: BTC/USD lost key support as hot CPI delayed easing.
MA20 breakdown and RSI at oversold signal bearish pressure.
Analysts watch $70K support after slide below $74K.
CRYPTO.excerpt: BTC slides below $74K; MA20 breakdown and RSI oversold signal bearish pressure.
CRYPTO.comment: BTC slides below $74K; MA20 breakdown and RSI oversold signal bearish pressure.
